title: L. A. Brown, Retired Farmer, Dies in Sherman
text:
L. A. Brown, Retired Farmer, Dies in Sherman

SAVOY — Funeral services will be held Thursday in the Savoy Church of Christ at a time to be announced for L. A. Brown, 81, a retired Savoy farmer who died in the home of a son, Paul Brown, 811 S. Walnut St., Sherman, Wednesday at 9:15 a.m.

Burial will be in Sunnyside Cemetery, near Savoy, directed by Earnheart Funeral Home of Whitewright.

Survivors are his wife; two other sons, Berry Brown of Wichita Falls and Jack Brown of Savoy; two sisters, Mrs. Lula Mitchell of Dallas and Mrs. Frank Ponder of Arkansas.
